Harmontide · a field guide to an inhabited world · volume VI · the spider family

Arachne

Five spider monster girls: a woman's upper body on a spider's abdomen and eight legs. Jumping spider, orb weaver, tarantula, trapdoor spider and wolf spider. They are builders and hunters, they make silk, and they are a great deal friendlier than their reputation.

The central similarity

Silk is everything.

Every arachne spins silk, and how she uses it is who she is: the orb weaver builds great wheel webs, the trapdoor spider silks a hidden door, the wolf spider spins only an egg sac and carries it with her. Silk is also her gift, her home and her bond.

  • SilkShe makes string over time (like a sheep regrows wool); a bonded arachne gives it to you.
  • Webs that fadeWebs she spins are temporary (they decay after a day), so no griefing.
  • Eight legs, eight eyesThey climb walls and ceilings and see in the dark. A sneaking player is invisible to their vibration sense.
  • Spider truceVanilla spiders and cave spiders are neutral to anyone an arachne is devoted to.

Relationships (shared by every family)

The same relationship core runs through all Harmontide families, from the harpies on. This volume only changes how a arachne builds trust, what she gives back, and how she bears young.

AffectionEach monster girl remembers every player separately. Feeding, petting and her family's own bond action raise it; hurting her lowers it. /harmontide bonds lists everyone nearby.
SitRight-click any monster girl with a plain stick to make her sit; again to let her get up.
Sharing a bedAt high friendship (25) she may join you in bed: once a night she decides, one in three at 25, certain at 100. Sleep through the night and she is expecting.
ExpectingA pregnancy lasts one in-game day. Her belly rounds out as it goes on (the model shows it).
Born devotedHer young are born devoted to the player who fathered them (full affection) and never share that player's bed.
PresentsAt high friendship every family brings presents of its own kind.
BondAffectionWhat it means
Wild0Keeps her distance; her species' instincts decide everything.
Curious3+Lets you come close and watches what you do.
Fond10+Follows you a little way, accepts petting, stops fleeing.
High friendship25+May join you in bed at night (one night in three, more the fonder she is) and brings presents.
Devoted60+The family's devoted perk unlocks (see each guide).
Full devotion100The most there is. Every daughter feels this for the player who fathered her.

Friendship

What builds trust

  • Raw chicken, rabbit, spider eyes, flies' stand-in: any food a spider would catch
  • Leaving her webs alone
  • Brushing her gently (silk, +1)
  • Bringing her string (she likes good silk)

What costs trust

  • Breaking her web or egg sac
  • Hitting her
  • Fire near her web

Devoted (60+)

She wraps presents for you: a silk cocoon with something inside (iron, gold, an enchanted book, a diamond rarely), and the spider truce covers you.

Mating & young

FormSilk egg sac (block); the wolf spider carries hers. YoungSpiderlings (2-3 stay of 4-6), grown in 5 days. WhereA wall or ceiling in a quiet, dark place. Spiderlings use the adult model at 35% scale.

1. CourtshipAt high friendship she may join you in bed (she curls her legs around it and is surprisingly cuddly). And no: she does not eat her mate. By morning she is expecting.
2. The egg sacShe spins a round silk egg sac (a block) on a wall or ceiling in a quiet place and guards it. The orb weaver hangs hers in her web; the wolf spider carries hers on her spinnerets instead.
3. SpiderlingsFour to six tiny spiderlings hatch. Most go ballooning (they float away on silk threads and are gone), and two or three stay. The wolf spider's spiderlings ride on her back for their first day.
4. GrownSpiderlings grow up in five days and are devoted to their father.

Behaviour & gameplay (shared by the family)

SilkEach arachne regrows silk: about one string every in-game hour. Brush her (the vanilla brush) to collect it, gently. Bonded ones bring silk as a present, sometimes a whole bundle (cobweb).
WebsWild arachne build lairs of web that slow intruders. A bonded orb weaver spins a web across your house's door or yard at night that catches phantoms and bats; it fades by day.
Wall walkingAll five climb walls and walk on ceilings (the trapdoor spider prefers not to). They hang from silk to descend.
Venom & wrapTheir bite slows (Slowness) and the stronger ones poison. Prey they catch is wrapped in silk: a cocoon that holds the mob's drops.
Vibration senseThey feel footsteps through the ground: they notice walking players from far away and sneaking players only up close.
Spider truceSpiders and cave spiders treat an arachne as one of their own and never attack her. Devoted, she extends the truce to you.

Species profiles

Meadows, plains & flower forestsCurious · tiny

Jumping Spider (about 1.3 blocks)

TemperamentCurious, playful, fearless

Ecology & behaviourThe smallest and only daytime arachne, with two enormous front eyes. Hunts by sight, stalking and then leaping, always on a safety line of silk.

Signature: Leap & shiny thingsShe leaps up to eight blocks to a target (a safety line means no fall damage). She follows any player holding gold, diamonds or emeralds, head tilting, and bonds fastest of the family.

Player interactionHold something shiny. She will watch it and follow it anywhere.

Orb Weaver (about 1.7 blocks)

TemperamentPatient, artistic, house-proud

Ecology & behaviourBuilds a new great wheel web between trees every night and eats it again in the morning. Sits head-down in the centre, waiting.

Signature: Hunting web and phantom netWild, she strings cobwebs round the spot she settled on and goes for whatever they catch (players included) until fed meat. Bonded, she spins a web at night by your bed instead; phantoms, bats and vexes are caught in it. It fades at dawn.

Player interactionWalk around her web, never through it. Compliment it with string.

Tarantula (about 1.8 blocks)

TemperamentDocile, slow, very cuddly

Ecology & behaviourBig, fuzzy and calm. Lives in a silk-lined burrow, wanders at night, and kicks a cloud of itchy hairs at anything that bothers her.

Signature: Itchy hairs & moultingAttackers get a face full of hairs (Nausea and Slowness). Every few days she moults and leaves an Exoskeleton (it works like Shed Skin). Petting builds affection twice as fast.

Player interactionMove slowly and offer food. She loves being held (petting builds double).

DangerLow.

Trapdoor Spider (about 1.6 blocks)

TemperamentA homebody, territorial, deeply loyal

Ecology & behaviourLives in a burrow with a silk-hinged trapdoor (a real trapdoor block) and almost never leaves it. Feels footsteps through her silk tripwires and lunges out.

Signature: Burrow ambushShe digs a hole in soft ground, sinks into it out of sight and bursts out at anything that comes within three blocks. Wild, that includes you, until she is fed meat. Calm, only monsters.

Player interactionThrow her meat before she bursts out at you; more meat after that.

Wolf Spider (about 1.7 blocks)

TemperamentBrisk, motherly, brave

Ecology & behaviourSpins no web at all: she runs her prey down. Carries her egg sac on her spinnerets and then her spiderlings on her back. Her eyes shine in torchlight.

Signature: Carries her young & eyeshineHer spiderlings ride on her back for their first day. Her eyes glow (a glow mask). Bonded, she runs ahead of you and hunts down hostile mobs first.

Player interactionFollow the eyeshine at night. Bring her raw meat.

TemperamentSweet, patient

Ecology & behaviourThe “binding bride” of Japanese folklore: a spider who walks as a girl in a web-patterned kimono, with four red eyes and eight long legs spread behind her back.

In the game

Built (2026-10-19)

  • Silk regrowth and brushing
  • Wall climbing (not the trapdoor spider)
  • Venom
  • Spider truce for devoted players
  • Silk-wrapped presents
  • Orb weaver's phantom net of temporary cobwebs at night
  • Tarantula's itchy hairs, double petting and moulting
  • Jumping spider's leap, safety line and love of shiny things
  • Egg sac on the ground; the wolf spider carries her spiderlings
  • Bed perk: Night Vision
  • Black Widow: poisons and slows the monsters near her friend. Peacock Spider: dances for villagers, better prices. Cave Spider: clears cobwebs for string
  • Spoodr: befriended, she clears the cobwebs near her friend and gives them the string
  • Ushi-oni: befriended, her bellow sends the monsters near her friend fleeing, slowed
  • Jorogumo: walks on two legs, eight spider legs fanned behind her back; at night, befriended, she binds the monsters near her friend in cobwebs that melt after ten seconds
  • Trapdoor spider and orb weaver attack strangers until fed meat; more meat builds friendship
  • Trapdoor spider digs a hole, hides in it and bursts out at whatever comes within three blocks
  • Wild orb weavers string a hunting web of cobwebs and go for whatever it catches

Not yet

  • Vibration sense
  • Wolf spider eyeshine

Design decisions log

Decided (2026-10-19)

  • No peacock spider: the famous display belongs to the males.
  • Webs she spins decay after a day, so a bonded arachne can never grief a base.
  • Mainly fantasy: she does not eat her mate (this is said in the guide on purpose).

Open questions

  • Should the silk cocoon present be a block you break or an item you open?
  • Should spider-truce cover cave spiders in mineshafts too?
